module_summary: Traffic light controller: 4-state FSM sequences red/green/yellow next-value registers, a reloadable down-counter times phases, and outputs are registered copies.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Light FSM idle/red/green/yellow, advancing when cnt reaches 3

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Phase down-counter reloaded 60/5/10 on light changes, gates FSM transitions

anchors.name: pass_request
anchors.why: Pedestrian request shortens green countdown to 10

anchors.name: p_green
anchors.why: FSM-decoded next light values; edge vs outputs triggers cnt reload

anchors.name: green
anchors.why: Registered green light output; also qualifies pedestrian shortening

anchors.name: red
anchors.why: Registered red light output from p_red

anchors.name: yellow
anchors.why: Registered yellow light output from p_yellow

groups.name: Light FSM
groups.description: Sequences lights and produces next-light registers

groups.name: Phase timer
groups.description: Down-counter with phase reloads and pedestrian shortening
